cause.what_happened: SUGP fell 14.1% to $1.915 by 15:05 ET (gap -3.6%, intraday -10.9%) on 0.69x normal dollar volume ($276k), with no filing since 2026-10-02 and no wire story found. It is the fourth session after a 1-for-6 share consolidation effective at the open on 2026-10-07, the second reverse split in two months, after the share count went from ~1.42m (post 6 Aug split) to ~9.01m pre-split through warrant exercises at $0.70.

pipeline.next_dated_event: Warrant Periodic Adjustment (Section 3(l)), six months after the 13 May 2026 issue, so about 2026-11-13: the exercise price and floor reset to the lower of the existing floor and 20% of the Nasdaq Minimum Price. Outside the window.

outside_window.finding: Warrant Periodic Adjustment (Section 3(l) of the May-2026 warrant form): on each six-month Periodic Adjustment Date the exercise price and the Exercise Price Floor reset to the lower of the existing floor and 20% of the Nasdaq Minimum Price (lowest VWAP over five trading days). First date about 2026-11-13, six months after the 13 May issue. The floor is about $4.20 post-split against $1.915 spot, so a reset could re-open exercise into roughly 5-6m+ post-split shares against ~1.5m outstanding, the same mechanism as the 21 Aug -42% day.

The company has amended the warrant price twice (2026-06-17 to $0.87, 2026-08-21 to $0.70), citing capital needs; a third amendment to bring the now out-of-the-money warrants back into the money is possible but has no date.
Nasdaq minimum bid price: the split took the price to ~$1.9, above $1 now, but the stock has lost ~86% in 60 days; any new deficiency notice would come only after 30 sub-$1 sessions.
